Vishal Sood

Founding Member & President, R&D

Vishal Sood is a founding member and President of R&D at Typeface, where he leads product, engineering, and design for the company's AI-first platform transforming how brands create and scale content.

He has driven innovations including Arc agents and Spaces, helping position Typeface as a category-defining marketing orchestration platform. Previously, Vishal was a General Manager at Microsoft, where he led the incubation and launch of mixed reality products such as Dynamics 365 Guides and Remote Assist. He brings more than 20 years of experience building zero-to-one enterprise products.
